root.label: Fraggle dolphin carries dead calf south of Perth

events.label: Fraggle dolphin carries dead calf south of Perth

slots.name: calf age
slots.sentence: A mother dolphin was spotted carrying the dead body of her two-week-old calf south of Perth, Australia.

slots.name: calves lost
slots.sentence: She had already lost three other calves, and giving birth to a fourth during winter in the Southern Hemisphere posed an immediate challenge to the calf’s survival.
